analysis.reason: 4일 연속 음봉 마감하며 하락세 지속. RSI는 과매도 구간 진입 후 반등 시도 중이나, MACD 히스토그램은 악화되며 하락 추세가 유지되고 있음. SMA100 지지선($1575.79)이 근접해 있어 추가 하락 시 매수 고려 가능하나, 추세 전환 신호 부재로 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: Continued decline with 4 consecutive daily closes in the red. RSI is attempting a rebound after entering oversold territory, but the MACD histogram is worsening, maintaining the downtrend. The SMA100 support ($1575.79) is approaching, suggesting potential buying if it holds, but a lack of trend reversal signals warrants a wait-and-see approach.

[모멘텀 지표]

· 스윙 저항선 ($1603.49) — 단기 저항선으로 작용

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (1.78배) — 최근 움직임에 대한 거래량 증가, 변동성 확대
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) — SMA100 지지 확인 시 매수 고려, 추세 전환 신호 부재로 관망 유지
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1582.95) vs SMA5/20/50 ($1718.21/$1774.52/$1740.95) — Below short/mid-term moving averages, indicating a weak position.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($1575.79/$1378.06) — Approaching SMA100, signaling weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (68.3%) + Current price level is high relative to historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.9 → 37.0) — Attempting rebound after entering oversold territory, weak trend persists.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-11.5578 → -22.5871) — Worsening, strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $1623.47) — Approaching lower band, confirming downward pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($1441.31) — SMA100 ($1575.79) acting as a near-term support.
· Swing Resistance ($1603.49) — Acting as a short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways) — No trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.78x) — Increased volume on recent moves, indicating expanding volatility.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation) — Consider buying if SMA100 support holds, maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to lack of trend reversal signals.
analysis.patternNote: 4일 연속 음봉으로 하락세가 이어지고 있으며, SMA100 지지선에 근접하고 있다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The downtrend continues with 4 consecutive daily bearish candles, approaching the SMA100 support level.
keyPoints: RSI는 과매도 구간에서 반등 시도를 하고 있으나, MACD 히스토그램은 지속적으로 악화되며 하락 추세가 강화되고 있습니다.
SMA100 지지선($1575.79)이 근접해 있어 단기 반등 가능성이 있으나, 추세 전환 신호가 명확하지 않아 관망이 필요합니다.
거래량 비율이 1.78로 높아 변동성이 확대되고 있으나, 방향성은 아직 불확실합니다.
keyPointsEn: RSI is attempting a rebound from oversold territory, but the MACD histogram continues to worsen, strengthening the downtrend.
The SMA100 support level ($1575.79) is approaching, suggesting potential short-term bounces, but a lack of clear trend reversal signals necessitates a cautious approach.
The volume ratio of 1.78 indicates expanding volatility, but the direction remains uncertain.
analysis.riskNote: ADX가 13.4로 추세가 형성되지 않은 상태에서 급락이 발생하여, 충격성 변동 후 되돌림 가능성이 존재합니다.
